correctness.rationale: A legal linear word corresponds bijectively to a path of de Bruijn length-n windows with no palindromes or repeated reversal-pair labels. The recursion over suffix and used-pair bitset enumerates every extension once, and complement pairs all first-bit-zero rooted paths. Independent from-scratch exhaustive enumeration found n=6: 11 normalized,22 labeled,6 R/C orbits,2 RC fixed; n=7:1647 normalized,3294 labeled,829 R/C orbits,22 RC fixed; no admissible length 27 or 49, each maximizer balanced. Source verify_bitmask.py and verify_direct.py implement complete independent representations. Recursion is a finite exhaustive proof for n=6,7 only; not an infinite-n extrapolation.
residual_risks: Exact census depends on correctness of complete finite traversal and conventions (linear rather than cyclic); second verifier source inspected as companion evidence.
